scope: Current enriched Buscador SEACE rows at PG snapshot; not current/open accreditation. Not the full 1736-ID mapping.
input_per_request: Only complete tender title/object plus fixed taxonomy/questions; no PDFs, company profile, document text, embeddings or recommendations
prompt_strategy: six independent category decisions plus one clarity choice; multiple labels allowed

token_estimate.method: cl100k_base over compact full request JSON, includes repeated instructions/criteria. Proxy only, not provider tokenizer or billing quote.
token_estimate.range_method: 0.75x proxy to 1.5x proxy +256 tokens/request. Heuristic margin, not calibrated or a hard cap.

scope_selection.first: Current SEACE inventory only; deduplicate exact whitespace-normalized full title, preserve accents/numbers/brands. Existing documentary categories prevail.
scope_selection.later: Mapping-only candidates and menores require separate explicit source/ID inventory before execution; no source HTTP needed for stored titles.

replay_policy: Cache/reserve by normalized full-title SHA + catalogue/prompt/model/version. Reuse identical titles; preserve sent-uncertain requests without automatic retries. Do not add model calls to active frozen runtime.
planned_storage: Separate title classification per source/ID/title hash; provider response/usage, prompt/catalog/model/version, category probabilities and preliminary status. Never write invented PDF pages or overwrite raw extractions or matching scores.
planned_ui: One Categoría column, one or more category labels; Otros / Por confirmar. Documentary categories override preliminary title labels. Filter/order/count before pagination needs explicit backend integration.

cleanup.retained: Compact PG title inventory and request template for proposed backfill; active DIN inputs and receipts untouched

validation: Independent offline audit confirmed source IDs, title dedup and payload coverage; principal integrated development/configuration boundary fix and recomputed the full proxy. Zero inference or business writes. Provider tokenizer/billing not measured.
semantic_notes: Development requires creating code; standalone implementation/configuration is not development.
Title support/maintenance question intentionally covers technology/industrial maintenance; broad documentary work-type alone is not area-restricted.
Per-category noul values are model signals, not validated domain confidence or tender-winning probability. Inclusion/unclear thresholds need pilot validation.
